documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY26, driven by owned fleet expansion, disciplined execution, operational efficiency, and effective cost management. Consolidated total income reached INR322.64 crores, EBITDA increased to INR152.55 crores, and PAT rose to INR80.80 crores. Looking ahead, management remains optimistic about opportunities in the offshore and maritime sectors, supported by government initiatives and favorable demand-supply dynamics. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26, alongside an EBITDA of ₹152.55 Cr. Management highlighted the induction of the OSV 'HADES' and an MPSV vessel during H2 FY26 to expand the company's offshore asset base and execution capabilities.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10 percent increase in turnover from current levels in the current financial year assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects the EBITDA margin band of 45 to 50 percent to continue.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

guidance.claim: Management estimates the tax rate for FY27 to be a maximum of 1.5% to 2%.
guidance.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand for offshore vessels remains strong due to favorable demand-supply dynamics, an aging global fleet, and limited new vessel additions.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The total cost of acquisition for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV, was about $15 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: An MPSV vessel was delivered to advance offshore capabilities during H2 FY26.
The company received delivery of the offshore vessel AM Passion in H1 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Received Delivery of Offshore Vessel – AM PASSION

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores in FY26, with the EBITDA margin expanding sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income grew by 78.93% year-on-year to INR183.11 crores.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently operates a fleet of 12 vessels, consisting of owned vessels and smaller vessels on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat. Four of them, two of them running in Chennai Port and two of them are running in Ennore Port. So, totally we have a, you know, 12 vessels.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured an offshore charter contract from Larsen & Toubro for a DP2 Platform Supply Vessel.
orders_capacity.quote: Secured Offshore Charter Contract from L&T

orders_capacity.claim: The company bagged a port services project at Deendayal Port worth ₹3.79 Cr.
orders_capacity.quote: Bagged Port Services Project at Deendayal Port

orders_capacity.claim: The AM Passion vessel was deployed under a 3-year firm plus 3-year optional extension charter with Schlumberger Asia Services Limited.
orders_capacity.quote: AM PASSION Deployed Under Schlumberger Charter

management_commitments.claim: Management affirmed its commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
